# Highlights from Benchtalk West


Kyrstin Lou Ward


Posted on


May 20, 2019


This April, Benchling hosted its first West Coast User Forum: Benchtalk West. Leaders from the life sciences community gathered together to share groundbreaking research and discuss ideas about the path forward for the field. Watch the recap!
